subject: Rollforward plan for v2 model transition — comms, exemptions, and SLA alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rollforward plan for v2 model transition — draft playbook and exemptions

Team —

Posting a first draft of a short rollforward playbook attached (rollforward_playbook_v1.pdf). High level ask: we need a concise cross-functional plan to transition hosted customers from model v1 -> v2 for the API endpoint by 2027-09-01. Key constraints from sales/procurement so far: Acme Analytics has asked for an exemption window until EOY unless we can provide a contractual SLA credit and SOC2 evidence.

Specific asks:
- Product (Karthik): confirm compatibility risk areas (embeddings drift, tokenization changes, response shape) and whether we can ship a compatibility shim for 3 months.
- Sales (Ben): identify which customers will need explicit exception agreements and who owns the MA/contract updates.
- Security/Compliance (Monica): confirm the minimal SOC2 artifacts we can share and timeline for delivery.

Proposed timeline:
- 2027-07-05: finalize playbook and comms templates
- 2027-07-12: circulate customer-specific M.A.P. drafts (Excel attached for Acme)
- 2027-08-01: enable v2 by default for new tenants; opt-in toggle for at-risk customers
- 2027-09-01: cutover / v1 disabled for public routes (exceptions handled case-by-case)

Please review the playbook and flag major blockers today. If Acme (and two other tier-1 customers) require exemption that extends beyond 2027-09-01, we need a path for either (a) a contract amendment with SLA credits, or (b) a technical forebearance (compatibility shim + monitoring).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rollforward plan for v2 model transition — draft playbook and exemptions

Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick technical notes from Product/Infra:
- Compat shim: feasible as a request-routing layer that pins callers to a v1 replica for 12 weeks post-cutover; adds ~8-12ms latency on average but keeps production behavior stable. We need infra hours to keep v1 pools for the exemption cohort.
- Tokenization: v2 uses a slightly updated tokenizer that changes embedding offsets for ~3% of records. For customers using embeddings for dedup/ID matching (Acme flagged this) we should offer an embedding backfill as part of the exemption package.
- Metrics: we should add a regression monitor (prompt sets + sample traffic) to the playbook and gate any exemptions if model quality slips > 3% on key prompts.

I can sketch a short tech appendix for the playbook (API flags, routing, cost delta) by EOD Friday. Need clarity on whether exceptions will be "time-limited (X weeks)" or "contractually open until PO completion" — they'll drive how long we keep v1 live.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director of Product — Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rollforward plan for v2 model transition — draft playbook and exemptions

Quick sales view —
- Acme is asking for an exemption until EOY unless we provide a 6‑month SLA credit (they want a 10% uptime credit) and SOC2 artifacts. Procurement signaled long review cycles.
- They are a strategic pilot customer; loss of access would materially impact their roadmap (they run near-real-time inference for analytics pipelines).
- Suggestion: offer a limited 90-day technical exemption + a 20% one-time credit on overage for transition months, and accelerate SOC2 summary delivery. This gives us a bounded cost while addressing procurement concerns.

I will own the customer M.A.P. and coordinate with procurement. Sending a draft M.A.P. (Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx) to include the technical exemptions, timelines, and credit language — please review.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
